_comment: Thumbnail directions — MALZ-quality family. All six share the winning DNA (bright golden subject, near-black background, extreme contrast, instantly readable at small size) but vary the SUBJECT so consecutive uploads don't look copy-pasted. Rotation rule: never the same direction twice in a row, max twice in the last 6 uploads. Every direction hard-bans murky dark-on-dark images (the failure mode: a thumbnail that reads as a black rectangle in the feed).

directions.subject: A magnificent carved African ceremonial mask with polished GOLD inlay, cowrie-shell crown and dark afro hair, facing the viewer, filling 75% of the frame.
directions.image_rules:
1. STYLE: ultra-detailed photorealistic render, museum-artifact quality.
2. PALETTE: radiant GOLD + rich dark wood on a near-black background with a faint tribal pattern glowing softly behind.
3. LIGHT: strong warm key light — the gold GLOWS and pops off the dark background.
4. COMPOSITION: subject centered, huge, instantly readable as a tiny 200px thumbnail.
5. MOOD: majestic, premium, iconic — like a luxury album cover.
FORBIDDEN: murky dark-on-dark, dim lighting, small subject, clutter, neon blue/purple, cartoon.

directions.subject: A regal African queen with a gleaming gold beaded headdress and gold face paint accents, luminous skin, eyes closed in trance, filling 70% of the frame.
directions.image_rules:
1. STYLE: hyper-realistic cinematic portrait, glossy magazine quality.
2. PALETTE: glowing bronze skin + brilliant GOLD jewelry + one deep CRIMSON accent, near-black background.
3. LIGHT: dramatic golden rim light on both sides — face is BRIGHT and dimensional.
4. COMPOSITION: face large and centered, sharp, readable at small size.
5. MOOD: divine, magnetic, powerful.
FORBIDDEN: dark murky tones, underexposed face, busy background, neon, flat illustration.

directions.subject: A muscular drummer striking a djembe, sparks and embers flying, silhouetted against a MASSIVE wall of golden-orange fire light.
directions.image_rules:
1. STYLE: cinematic action shot, motion energy frozen mid-strike.
2. PALETTE: blazing ORANGE-GOLD fire glow dominating the frame, deep black silhouette for contrast.
3. LIGHT: the background IS the light source — bright, hot, alive with embers.
4. COMPOSITION: dynamic diagonal, drummer fills 60% of frame.
5. MOOD: explosive, primal, festival energy.
FORBIDDEN: dim images, cold colors, small distant subject, clutter, cartoon.

directions.subject: A majestic lion head sculpted in dark wood with radiant GOLD mane details and tribal engravings, facing forward, filling 75% of the frame.
directions.image_rules:
1. STYLE: ultra-detailed photorealistic sculpture render, premium artifact look.
2. PALETTE: dark carved wood + luminous GOLD accents on near-black with a faint glowing tribal pattern.
3. LIGHT: strong warm spotlight — gold highlights BLAZE against the dark.
4. COMPOSITION: symmetric, huge, iconic, readable as a tiny thumbnail.
5. MOOD: royal, fierce, timeless.
FORBIDDEN: murkiness, low contrast, small subject, neon, cartoon, photography of real animals.

directions.subject: A graceful dancer mid-leap, pure black silhouette against a HUGE blazing golden-amber sun filling the sky, dust glittering in the light.
directions.image_rules:
1. STYLE: cinematic golden-hour photography, epic scale.
2. PALETTE: the frame is DOMINATED by bright AMBER-GOLD sky — warm, radiant, vivid.
3. LIGHT: giant sun as backdrop, rim-lit dust particles sparkle.
4. COMPOSITION: dancer centered on the sun disc, strong simple shapes readable at small size.
5. MOOD: euphoric, free, breathtaking.
FORBIDDEN: dark gloomy sky, night scenes, low contrast, clutter, small subject.

directions.subject: An intense close-up of a young African warrior's face with metallic GOLD war paint streaks, piercing bright eyes looking straight at the viewer, filling 80% of the frame.
directions.image_rules:
1. STYLE: hyper-realistic cinematic close-up, razor sharp.
2. PALETTE: warm bronze skin + brilliant GOLD paint + one deep TEAL accent stripe, near-black background.
3. LIGHT: powerful warm key light — the face is BRIGHT, eyes catch the light.
4. COMPOSITION: extreme close-up, eyes on the upper third, magnetic eye contact.
5. MOOD: fierce, hypnotic, impossible to scroll past.
FORBIDDEN: underexposed face, murky shadows swallowing detail, busy background, neon, cartoon.
